title: A section of an invertible module trivializes it where it does not vanish
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme, $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] and $s\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L)$. Put $Y_s=\{y\in Y:\ s_y\notin\mathfrak m_y\mathcal L_y\}$ (equivalently, the set of $y$ where the value $s(y)$ of $s$ in $\mathcal L_y\otimes_{\mathcal O_{Y,y}}\kappa(y)$ is nonzero; $\kappa(y)$ the residue field [def-weil-residue-field]). Then $Y_s$ is open in $Y$, and the map $\mathcal O_{Y_s}\to\mathcal L|_{Y_s}$, $a\mapsto a\,s|$, is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{Y_s}$-modules. Consequently, for every open $V\subseteq Y_s$ and every $t\in\mathcal L(V)$ there is a unique $a\in\mathcal O_Y(V)$ with $t=a\cdot s|_V$; it is written $t/s$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma (Tag 01CY, label lemma-s-open) and its proof (for $y\in Y_s$, $s_y$ is a basis of the free rank-one module $\mathcal L_y$ by Nakayama; the inverse section $s'$ of $\mathcal L^{\otimes-1}$ over $Y_s$ with $s'(s|_{Y_s})=1$)

proof.text: Convert Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible to SheafOfModules.IsInvertible using IsInvertible.sheafOfModules_isInvertible. At each point choose an affine trivialization with a free generator e (exists_isFreeGenerator). The private helper stalk_generator_bijective proves that the germ e_x is a free generator of the stalk: represent arbitrary module germs on smaller opens and apply sectionwise surjectivity; represent two scalar germs on smaller opens, shrink until equality holds, and apply sectionwise injectivity.

Write s restricted to the trivializing affine V as c times e. Since a ↦ a e_x is bijective, the stalk is spanned by e_x, and Submodule.mem_smul_span_singleton shows c_x e_x belongs to the maximal ideal times the stalk exactly when c_x belongs to the maximal ideal. Thus x is in nonvanishingLocus exactly when c_x is a unit. Scheme.mem_basicOpen and the source-library basicOpen_coeff_eq identify this with x lying outside the support of Hom.zeroLocus (homOfGlobalSection L s). The latter complement is already an open U; the private helper nonvanishing_eq_compl_support proves equality of its underlying set with the required locus.

Use the already proved source-library isFreeGenerator_app_one_of_le on U, the complement of the zero scheme support. This lemma uses the same local coefficient basic opens and inverts c on D(c); therefore Nakayama and the stalkwise isomorphism criterion are unnecessary. homOfGlobalSection_app_one and composition of restrictions give bijectivity of a ↦ a times s restricted to V for every V ≤ U.

Forget the restricted sheaf morphism to its underlying presheaf of abelian groups. Evaluation at an object V → U is exactly multiplication by s on V; the bijectivity just proved makes every component an isomorphism. NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app and reflection of isomorphisms through the forgetful functors give IsIso of overFunctor.map (homOfGlobalSection L s). Finally surjectivity chooses the scalar a for each t and injectivity proves its uniqueness.

split_report.summary: Split in seven steps following Stacks 01CY: (1) the two descriptions of Y_s agree (M⊗κ = M/𝔪M); (2) on a trivializing open U, s = g·e and Y_s∩U = D(g), stalks L_y free of rank one; (3) Y_s open via the new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-basic-open-function (Scheme.basicOpen, mem_basicOpen, evaluation_ne_zero_iff_mem_basicOpen, isUnit_res_basicOpen; Stacks Schemes 01HZ); (4) μ: a ↦ a·s is O-linear; (5) μ_y bijective at y∈Y_s by Nakayama (lem-weil-pbc-nakayama-local-generators) plus a written-out injectivity argument; (6) μ an isomorphism by lem-weil-pbc-module-iso-on-stalks; (7) the unique quotient t/s. Openness uses the local trivialization (as in the proof of Properties 01PW) rather than Stacks' section of L^{⊗-1}, so no dual/tensor nodes are needed; the statement does not claim the section s' of L^{⊗-1} and is unchanged. def-pc-scheme added to stmt_deps.
